items.quote: Seriously? This is the world we are living now? Ai generated DMs, brainless conversations…
items.statement: Frustration with AI-generated communications and lack of depth in conversations.

items.quote: I want to start the movement of Banning this Account! Who is with me?
items.statement: Desire to advocate against AI-generated content in personal communication.

items.quote: And thanks god my misspelling and autocorrect keeps me a human.
items.statement: Acknowledges personal flaws with autocorrect and misspellings, valuing human imperfection.

overview: Reflective post expressing frustration with current communication trends.
